title: Common Ground
challenge: A refill-first cleaning brand with a real environmental case, dressed in the same muted greens as every other eco brand. Easy to approve of, and just as easy to forget.
insight: People don’t switch to refills to feel virtuous. They switch when it’s easier, and when it looks better at home than the bottle it replaces.
idea: We built the brand around ownership, not sacrifice. A forever bottle designed to stay out on the counter, bold refill pouches that read as one system, and a voice that’s confident rather than preachy.
outcome: Sustainability people choose for the design, not despite it.
